label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 150 ]

blocks.text: Modern man has lived on the Earth for only 35,000 years, but we have changed our planet in many ways in that time. Many of the things that we have done are good, but many more are not good for the Earth. We have created traffic pollution, Global warming, and acid rain. These problems are very serious for our future. But we can do something now! In many places, people have already taken action to improve the environment.

readingSentences.english: Modern transportation has shrunk the globe into a single neighborhood.
readingSentences.korean: 현대의 교통수단은 지구를 하나의 이웃으로 축소시켰다.

readingSentences.english: High-speed trains and commercial aircraft allow us to travel thousands of miles in hours.
readingSentences.korean: 고속열차와 민간 항공기는 우리가 수천 마일을 몇 시간 만에 이동할 수 있게 해준다.

readingSentences.english: This interconnectedness promotes global trade and cross-cultural understanding.
readingSentences.korean: 이러한 상호 연결성은 국제 무역과 문화 간 이해를 크게 촉진한다.

readingSentences.english: Yet it also calls for international cooperation to manage shared ecological impacts.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 그것은 또한 공유된 생태적 영향을 관리하기 위한 국제적인 협력을 요구한다.
